name: Pilot or carrier receiver relay
summary: Receives a communication-assisted protection signal used in a pilot or carrier scheme.
description: Receives a communication-assisted protection signal used in a pilot or carrier scheme.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the local and remote protection endpoints and channel.
